name: @repo/state-graph-render
description: GraphViz DOT -> SVG for the "Show state graph" pane, via @viz-js/viz (Graphviz compiled to WebAssembly, embedded in one JS file: no .wasm asset, no worker, no fetch). The one place the renderer is named, so it can be swapped without touching a host. See specs/todo/lexipedia-superset/LTS-VISUALISER.md §4.8.

scripts.clean: git clean -fdx dist || echo 'git not available'
